messages:
maria: Heads-up: eu-west pool provisioning stuck — several GPU nodes in Pending. Cloud logs show keystore signing failures after the privnet egress change. KMS returning 403s :warning:
aj: seeing it too. node bootstrap fails while fetching certs, keystore-proxy 503/403 loops
infra-bot: Deploy failed: keystore-proxy v1.9 -> 503 retries=12
samir: did we flip the stricter privnet ACL last night? I recall a change around 02:14 UTC
maria: yes — @kevin applied tighter egress deny to keystore-subnet to lock down external calls
kevin: confirmed, I pushed an ACL to block outbound 443 to the old external keystore endpoint and added a privatelink route. canaries didn't catch the DNS race
aj: root cause looks like: nodes still resolving keystore FQDN to external while privatelink config and DNS sync are incomplete -> attempts hit external keystore which is now blocked -> 403
samir: quick mitigation: revert the ACL so nodes can reach external keystore while DNS+privatelink converge. rollback will unblock joins
maria: +1. @kevin can you revert and we re-evaluate fallback to eu-west-1 keystore if needed
kevin: reverting now. command I ran:
```
aws ec2 revoke-security-group-egress --group-id sg-keystore --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 0.0.0.0/0
```
kevin: revoke completed at 4912345710
aj: staging warmpool back to healthy (3/3 nodes joined) after revert. prod warmpool still pending some joins
maria: intermediate fix idea: allow a short-lived egress exception for keystore signing until the privatelink endpoint and DNS records fully converge
samir: audit shows repeated KMS:Decrypt 403s from node join role arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/node-join. Looks like an IAM boundary change removed sts:AssumeRole for node join principal
kevin: right — I rolled an IAM boundary earlier in rollout. I'll add explicit sts:AssumeRole allow for node-join principal and push a targeted fix
aj: if we need to shift load to eu-west-1 for throughput, heads up on cost: inter-region egress + unused reserved capacity in eu-west will bump spend
maria: rough estimate: shifting ~20% of traffic to eu-west-1 for ~2h => ~ $1.2k incremental (egress + inefficiency). preferable to a multi-hour provisioning outage if we can't unblock quickly
kevin: IAM patch applied at 4912345765
infra-bot: IAM patch applied by kevin at 4912345767
aj: prod warmpool now processing join queue, nodes joining 5/10 and ramping
samir: note for postmortem: ordering dependency = DNS -> privatelink -> ACL flip -> IAM boundary. Our rollout assumed the ordering but didn't gate the ACL until privatelink healthchecks passed
maria: I'll write a short runbook and add a gating step in the privnet playbook: don't flip ACL until privatelink healthcheck+dns sync signal. Also adding a temporary tracing tag to keystore-proxy logs: "privnet-sync"
aj: adding log tag + threshold alert. audit: 30m window showed ~472 keystore 403 errors tied to the rollout
maria: summary: revert ACL unblocked nodes, IAM patch fixed role assumption, partial failover not required. I'll own the postmortem including timeline, cost delta, and proposed deployment guard change
kevin: adding a temporary firewall exception for keystore egress until next canary completes. :white_check_mark:
samir: 👍 postmortem owner: maria
maria: assigning to myself. will include exact commands, timeline, metrics, and a PR for the guard
aj: thanks all — monitoring for next 2 hours
